stories.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
stories.take: A US intelligence memo reportedly says China's Ministry of State Security recruited a Megaspeed executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO — the chip war now has a human-intelligence front.

stories.title: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
stories.take: The midterms turned hostile for data centers and for Elon Musk — TechCrunch's Equity team unpacks why the political ground under Big Tech's building boom just shifted.

stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.take: OpenAI has reportedly raised another $11 billion in a round that has not closed yet, at a $1.25 trillion valuation — the AI money machine is not slowing down.

stories.title: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack
stories.take: Barely a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion from users, Binance's CFO is leaving to 'pursue a new venture' — the timing says more than the statement.

stories.title: Three men charged in US with using AI to impersonate CEOs and steal millions
stories.take: Three men were charged in the US with using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys and steal over $100 million — the deepfake fraud era is here.

stories.title: The Fridge-Hacking Spree Is an Internet-of-Things Wake-Up Call
stories.take: Hacks hitting blood labs and grocery stores trace back to basic security lapses on internet-connected fridges — critical infrastructure, consumer-grade security.

stories.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
stories.take: In tests where AI models were asked to break into simulated networks, DeepSeek and GLM were not far behind OpenAI's most advanced cyber model — free models are now serious hacking tools.

stories.title: Pastor Talarico, 3 Billion Views, and $56 Million on Broadcast: How James Talarico’s Team Flipped Texas
stories.take: Senator-elect James Talarico's creative director and paid media strategist explain the flip of Texas: 3 billion views and $56 million on broadcast — viral clips, deliberately converted into paid reach.

stories.title: The world's biggest library of scanned 3D assets is now free – and it seems that this time it's for good
stories.take: Epic's Quixel Megascans — thousands of scanned 3D models, decals and materials, the world's biggest library of its kind — is free again, and this time it looks permanent.

stories.title: Maxon aims to make 3D creation feel more natural with ZBrush and Cinema4D for the PROLED XDR MacBook and Apple Vision pro
stories.take: Maxon is bringing touch support and Spatial Preview to ZBrush and Cinema 4D for the PROLED XDR MacBook and Apple Vision Pro — 3D creation gets more hands-on.

stories.title: Martine Rose appointed creative director at Balenciaga
stories.take: Balenciaga named Martine Rose creative director — the first woman to lead the house in its 109-year history, a breakthrough in a white, male-dominated industry.

stories.title: #AskNewser: CNN, NBC News and NewsNation Executives Reflect on Their Election Night Coverage
stories.take: CNN, NBC News and NewsNation executives look back at election night — and say they were surprised by how early some of the races could be called.

stories.title: The Cybertruck is dead – what went wrong?
stories.take: Elon Musk is winding down the Cybertruck — Creative Bloq's postmortem asks what went wrong with the most hyped design miss of the EV era.

stories.title: Doncic's 53-point explosion pushes scoring average past 40 as Lakers roll
stories.take: Luka Dončić poured in a season-high 53 points as the Lakers beat Portland 124-118, pushing his scoring average to 40.1 per game — an MVP pace that looks unsustainable and keeps happening.

stories.title: In Cleveland return, James finishes with just eight points in 76ers' loss
stories.take: LeBron's Cleveland return was a dud: eight points on 3-for-12 shooting with six turnovers as Philadelphia lost the NBA Cup game to the Cavaliers 119-96.

stories.title: LeBron's fit, Maxey's heroics and Philly's 8-1 start
stories.take: Windhorst and MacMahon canvass the early superteam intel — how LeBron fits in Philadelphia, and why Tyrese Maxey's heroics have powered the 76ers' hot start.

stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis to 'step away' from NBA to prioritize his health
stories.take: Kristaps Porziņģis will 'step away' from the NBA to prioritize his health — he has not played a minute for Golden State this season.

stories.title: Young snags double-double in 'cool' return to Atlanta, but Wiz lose
stories.take: Trae Young got his double-double in a 'cool' but strange return to Atlanta — his first game there as a Wizard — but Washington still lost.

stories.title: Rivers: Giannis was playing games when trying to leave Bucks
stories.take: Doc Rivers says Giannis Antetokounmpo 'didn't want to be the bad guy' while trying to force his way out of Milwaukee last season — and calls the whole dance a game.

stories.title: Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg fulfills 'lifelong goal' with new home for his mom
stories.take: Warriors rookie Yaxel Lendeborg bought his mom a new home — a 'lifelong goal' for a player who credits her with saving his life.

stories.title: Your guide to MLB free agency: Rankings and contract projections for the top 50 free agents
stories.take: Kiley McDaniel ranks the top 50 free agents with contract projections — your map for what this winter's biggest names will actually get paid.

stories.title: MLB free agency: Six international players to know for the 2026-27 offseason
stories.take: No Ohtani-level prize this winter, but six international players are worth knowing — the overseas talent pipeline still runs deep.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Max Scherzer mulling another season, Ty France drawing interest, top Taiwanese reliever posted
stories.take: Saturday hot stove: Max Scherzer is mulling one more season, Ty France is drawing interest, and a top Taiwanese reliever has been posted.

stories.title: Witness: Clase 'inside' pitch info dried up amid Mizuhara case fallout
stories.take: A witness in the Clase-Ortiz case says the inside pitch information he bet on dried up as scrutiny from the Mizuhara scandal grew — the two betting cases are now explicitly linked.

stories.title: Blue Jays: Santander's anti-Muslim posts don't represent team
stories.take: Toronto says Anthony Santander's anti-Muslim social media posts do not represent the Blue Jays' values and beliefs — the team is distancing itself, fast.

stories.title: D-backs' Carroll has elbow surgery, expected to be ready for spring training
stories.take: Corbin Carroll had surgery on his right elbow this week and Arizona expects him ready for spring training in February — a scare, not a season threat.

stories.title: Six dead after gunman opens fire in Kraków market square, with three more victims found at suspect’s home
stories.take: The Kraków toll grew Saturday: six people killed in the market square attack and three more victims found at the suspect's home, with 16 wounded — Polish officials say the gunman held ultra-nationalistic views.

stories.title: Stephen Miller, Trump’s incoming chief of staff, pledges ‘total devotion’ to the president
stories.take: Stephen Miller, Trump's incoming chief of staff, pledged 'total devotion' to the president — a signal the White House will double down on the hardline immigration agenda after the midterm losses.

stories.title: Trump says he's asked UFC's Dana White to be his press secretary
stories.take: Trump says he has asked UFC chief Dana White to be his press secretary — the post-midterm White House shakeup reaches the podium.

stories.title: ‘People are active, they are fed up’: young voters fueled the Democratic wave
stories.take: Young voters swung decisively toward Democrats after helping Trump win in 2024 — Tufts data says the youth vote fueled the midterm wave.

stories.title: Israel’s president picks Yashar leader Gadi Eisenkot to form government
stories.take: Israel's president picked Gadi Eisenkot, Benjamin Netanyahu's strongest rival, to try to form a government after a deadlocked Knesset left Netanyahu without a majority.

stories.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
stories.take: US homelessness saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year, though nearly 700,000 people remain unhoused — the administration and advocates credit entirely different reasons.

stories.title: Wisconsin state patrol trooper detained by ICE released from custody
stories.take: The Wisconsin state patrol trooper detained by ICE at an airport on Thursday has been released — he immigrated at 14 and has waited seven years for his asylum case to be heard.

stories.title: Newsom appoints former aide convicted in domestic violence case to state commission
stories.take: Newsom appointed his former communications director Nathan Ballard — who pleaded no contest in a domestic violence case — to a state commission, and the criticism started immediately.

stories.title: Raman, L.A. leaders join in condemnation after ICE officers reportedly detain two near Boyle Heights hospital
stories.take: Mayor-Elect Nithya Raman and LA leaders condemned ICE after officers reportedly detained two people near a Boyle Heights hospital, calling the actions 'an affront.'

stories.title: Santa Anas and hotter fall temperatures sustain SoCal critical fire risks
stories.take: Santa Ana winds peaked Saturday, but above-normal temperatures and elevated fire risk will remain in Southern California through next week.

stories.title: Great America, the Bay Area's premier theme park, is closing for good. Here's when
stories.take: California's Great America will close for good after one more season — the Bay Area park generations grew up with is down to its farewell run.

stories.title: Feds move to dismiss case over 20,000 California ballots after Supreme Court denied appeal
stories.take: Federal prosecutors moved to dismiss the case over 20,000 California ballots after the Supreme Court denied the appeal to set them aside — the ballot fight is over.

stories.title: ‘Soul-hurting pain’: Victims’ families enraged at Newsom’s death row decision
stories.take: Victims' families reacted with 'soul-hurting pain' to Newsom commuting death row sentences to life in prison — the clemency backlash is now the story in California.
